events.role: Former Tennessee state health commissioner (2023-2025); 2026 Republican nominee for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District
events.affiliation: Republican; former Kentucky state senator and 2019 Republican lieutenant-governor running mate of Matt Bevin; appointed Tennessee health commissioner by Republican Gov. Bill Lee
events.event_type: reported potential conflict of interest from paid outside healthcare employment while serving as Tennessee health commissioner
events.source_title: Ralph Alvarado kept outside jobs while working as Tennessee health commissioner
events.subject_response: Alvarado declined an interview request. Campaign spokesman Andy Westberry said Alvarado commonly worked about 90 hours per week, commuted to Kentucky every other weekend to make rounds, and took the outside clinical work seriously. The Tennessee Department of Health said it does not comment on former employees.
events.summary: The Herald-Leader reported from financial disclosures that Alvarado maintained paid medical work while serving as Tennessee's health commissioner, including a Winchester practice, medical-director roles at multiple Kentucky nursing homes, a faith-based addiction treatment center, and chief medical officer work for Eventus WholeHealth. The report said his 2024 state pay was $199,586 and outside work paid at least $126,462, and raised questions about whether the outside roles created conflicts or were compatible with a full-time cabinet post. The report did not establish an ethics violation or criminal conduct.
events.reason_for_status: This is a current-window report by a reputable investigative outlet, and it documents the subject's qualifying Republican affiliation and former state executive role. The report presents potential conflicts and workload concerns, not an official ethics finding, criminal charge, adjudication, or proven misconduct. A subject-side campaign response is preserved, but only one independent current-window report was located, so the event is not auto-publishable under the two-independent-reports-plus-response rule. No duplicate was found in src/data/agent-findings.json or prior A06 inbox artifacts.
